classification.analysis: QuantHarness (forked here as QuantAgent) is a research multi-agent trading-analysis system built with LangChain/LangGraph, coordinating Indicator, Pattern, Trend, and Decision agents that read K-line charts and technical indicators (RSI, MACD, Stochastic) to produce LONG/SHORT trade recommendations with entry/exit/stop-loss levels. It ships a Flask web interface plus a Python API (TradingGraph), supports Claude, GPT, Qwen, and MiniMax as the underlying LLM, and comes from an academic paper (Stony Brook/CMU/Yale/Fudan) with published benchmarks - intended for researchers and quant-curious developers, not production trading.

use_cases.title: Get an LLM-generated LONG/SHORT trade call from live K-line data
Run a multi-agent chart-pattern and trend analysis pipeline
Swap in Claude, Qwen, or MiniMax as the trading-agent LLM backend
Reproduce or extend the QuantHarness academic benchmark results
